verdict.rationale: Reflect offers built-in AI features (GPT-4o/Claude toggle, AI palette, chat with notes) and an API/OAuth2 plus Zapier for connecting third-party apps, but there's no evidence of a first-party plugin ecosystem or ability to bring/connect arbitrary external LLMs or AI tools beyond the two baked-in model choices. missing for 10: evidence of a genuine third-party AI plugin/connector ecosystem, ability to bring custom/external LLMs beyond the two offered, official MCP or similar AI-tool integration, and independent corroboration of these AI connector claims.
